baseUrl.label: EverMemOS Server URL
baseUrl.help: Base URL of EverMemOS API. Self-hosted example: http://localhost:1995/api/v1. Cloud example: https://api.evermind.ai/api/v0 (supports ${EVERMEMOS_BASE_URL})

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.help: Optional for self-hosted; required for cloud. Sent as Authorization: Bearer <api_key> (supports ${EVERMEMOS_API_KEY})

groupId.label: Default Group ID
groupId.help: Optional group ID for scoping memories to a specific group

autoCapture.label: Auto-Capture
autoCapture.help: Automatically store conversation context after each agent turn

autoRecall.label: Auto-Recall
autoRecall.help: Automatically inject relevant memories before each agent turn

retrieveMethod.label: Retrieval Method
retrieveMethod.help: How to retrieve memories: keyword (BM25), vector (semantic), hybrid, rrf, or agentic

memoryTypes.label: Memory Types
memoryTypes.help: Which memory types to retrieve: episodic_memory, foresight, event_log, profile

topK.label: Top K Results
topK.help: Maximum number of memories to retrieve per search
